descriptions.d26l_setup_selection_sprites_802b49b0: Formats resource names from the context's prefix: Highlight (attached to the host, sized from context +20 or from that size times the +116 scale with z 1.0, then shown), Grey (attached and shown if found) and, when the +120 colour is non-zero, Blue, Green, Blue, Purple or Red for colours 1 to 5, else the text at 0x803d7e4c (attached). Missing Highlight or colour resources write an error string at +108. Layer comes from +35 plus 30 or 29 by mode +216. Finishes with 0x802b4e10 and destroys the name string.
